title: How to Build a Cardboard Bridge

segments.text: Today we are building a bridge out of nothing but cardboard.
A real bridge works by spreading weight out to both ends.
So start with two stacks of books, the same height.
Now lay one flat strip of cardboard across the gap.
Press the middle of the bridge. It bends straight away.
A flat bridge is weak, because nothing is holding it up.
Next, fold the strip into a zigzag, like a paper fan.
The folds turn one weak sheet into lots of small walls.
Lay the bridge across again and put a book on top.
Okay, keep adding books and count how many the bridge holds.
A good folded bridge can carry ten books or more.
Finally, try an arch bridge, and see which shape wins.
So what would your bridge look like?
